mechanisms.label: Energetics / explosives shortage
mechanisms.summary: The available evidence indicates that shortages of key energetic materials—RDX, HMX, TNT, nitrocellulose, and related propellants—are constraining the West’s ability to rebuild munitions stocks, while some efforts are underway to expand domestic production.  The data also shows that Europe’s reliance on imported nitrocellulose and single‑source TNT is a choke point, but recent expansions (e.g., Rheinmetall’s gunpowder plant) have reportedly alleviated the nitrocellulose shortage.  The UK Ministry of Defence is actively seeking new domestic producers of these materials, and Premier Explosives plans to increase its RDX/HMX output to 300 t in FY28.
